## Latest Publications {#latest-publications}

Up to 10 publications matching **Delftia**, newest publication date first, from Europe PMC. Database indexing can lag behind publication.

[Browse all Delftia publications on Europe PMC](https://europepmc.org/search?query=Delftia%20sort_date%3Ay)

```

## Latest Genomes {#latest-genomes}

The 10 most recently updated *Delftia* genome assemblies from the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA), including species and strains within the genus. **Updated dates refer to database records, not necessarily new genome releases.**

[Browse Delftia genome assemblies on ENA](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/advanced-search?result=assembly&amp;query=tax_tree%2880865%29)

```
